name: Finder of Lost Loves
description: The Finder of Lost Loves TV show was a 60 minute drama series on ABC about a private investigator who specialized in finding lost loves from the past for his heartbroken clients.

videos.title: Maxwell, Ltd.
videos.overview: Nikki Gatos looks for find her fiancé, who has disappeared, while James Osborne seeks to be reunited with his first love.

videos.title: Yesterday's Child
videos.overview: A woman who's engaged wants to find her former lover, and discovers that he is now a priest.

videos.title: Losing Touch
videos.overview: A woman asks for Cary's help in finding her missing twin sister, while Daisy helps a female attorney track down a past love, now a small-town doctor.

videos.title: White Lies
videos.overview: A woman asks Cary to track down her former lover and father of her son in the hopes that he will be able to save her son, who has leukemia, by matching his bone marrow.

videos.title: Echoes
videos.overview: Cary helps a man track down his fiancee who disappeared on their wedding day, only to discover she has been placed in the witness protection program.

videos.title: Goodbye, Sara
videos.overview: When a man asks Cary to find his grandaughter, Cary takes a special interest in her.

videos.title: Undying Love
videos.overview: Daisy helps a man who has been in a Cuban jail for seven years find his wife and Cary helps a man find the woman he fell in love with across the tracks at a train station.

videos.title: Old Friends
videos.overview: Daisy helps a young boy find his grandfather and Cary tracks down a former high school football star for a woman who had a crush on him.

videos.title: Portraits
videos.overview: A woman believes her ex-husband has taken her son and asks for Cary's help. Daisy is hired by a famous race car driver to find a woman in a painting he owns.

videos.title: A Gift
videos.overview: Daisy helps a ballerina tracks down the secret benefactor who sponsored her education and training. Cary helps a woman, who only has a few months to live, track down the daughter she gave up at birth.

videos.title: Forgotten Melodies
videos.overview: A doctor friend of Cary's asks for Cary's help in uncovering the identity of an amnesia patient. Daisy tracks down a former client of a talent agent.

videos.title: Last Wish
videos.overview: A dying, wealthy man asks Cary to find the son he disowned years ago. Two men show up and Cary must discover which one is the real son. Daisy helps a man track down the woman he fell in love with in Hawaii and discovers that she is a prostitute.

videos.title: Deadly Silence
videos.overview: A man asks Cary to track down his runaway daughter. When Cary locates her, he discovers that she is a witness to a murder and the man who hired him is the murderer.

videos.title: Wayward Dreams
videos.overview: Parents of a girl who went to make it big in Hollywood are concerned when they don't hear from her and hire Cary to track her down. A doctor asks Daisy to track down his son who resulted from an affair, but Daisy discovers the boy was actually conceived through artificial insemination

videos.title: From the Heart
videos.overview: A newspaper columnist asks Daisy to track down the girl who used to write letters but has recently stopped. Cary helps a wife find her husband who is haunted by the death of their young daughter.

videos.title: Aftershocks
videos.overview: A woman asks Cary to find her biological mother. An Army war veteran asks Daisy to find the woman he left behind when he went to war.

videos.title: Tricks
videos.overview: Daisy help a minister track down the mother of his daughter, who turns out to be a madame. Cary helps to end a feud between two of his best friends.

videos.title: Haunted Memories
videos.overview: A man asks for Cary's help in tracking down a woman he keeps seeing who looks just like the man's dead wife.

videos.title: Mr. Wonderful
videos.overview: Daisy helps her old college boyfriend search for a woman from his past. Cary helps a judge track down the judge's finacee's former boyfriend.

videos.title: Surrogates
videos.overview: Cary helps plan for the wedding between two childhood sweethearts he reunited, but the groom-to-be's son arrives claiming the bride-to-be is a fake.

videos.title: Final Analysis
videos.overview: Daisy helps a man tracks down the woman he loves, who is in hiding because her ex-boyfriend is violent. After Daisy reunites them, Daisy's life is threatened.

videos.title: Broken Promises
videos.overview: Cary helps a high school athlete track down his girlfriend who is supposedly away at boarding school. Cary discovers the girl is pregnant.

videos.title: Connections
videos.overview: Cary helps a rich, young man track down his former foster family and younger brother he left behind. Daisy helps a popular actor locate the elderly woman from a telephone service who encouraged him to follow his dreams. The elderly woman turns out to be a young woman.
